mapper.sql: n.notice_id, n.title, n.content, n.author_id, u.name AS author_name, n.pinned_yn, n.view_cnt, n.attach_group_id, n.dept_scope, n.created_at, n.updated_at, n.deleted_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO gw_notice (title, content, author_id, pinned_yn, dept_scope, created_by) VALUES (#{title}, #{content}, #{authorId}, COALESCE(#{pinnedYn},'N'), COALESCE(#{deptScope},'ALL'), #{authorId})
mapper.update: UPDATE gw_notice SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, pinned_yn = COALESCE(#{pinnedYn}, pinned_yn), dept_scope = COALESCE(#{deptScope}, dept_scope), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{authorId} WHERE notice_id = #{noticeId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE gw_notice SET view_cnt = view_cnt + 1 WHERE notice_id = #{noticeId}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM gw_notice n LEFT JOIN gw_user u ON u.user_id = n.author_id WHERE n.notice_id = #{noticeId} AND n.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM gw_notice n WHERE n.deleted_at IS NULL
AND (LOWER(n.title) LIKE LOWER('%' || #{keyword} || '%') OR LOWER(n.content) LIKE LOWER('%' || #{keyword} || '%'))
SELECT FROM gw_notice n LEFT JOIN gw_user u ON u.user_id = n.author_id WHERE n.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY n.pinned_yn DESC, n.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO gw_notice_comment (notice_id, author_id, content) VALUES (#{noticeId}, #{authorId}, #{content})
mapper.select: SELECT c.cmt_id, c.notice_id, c.author_id, u.name AS author_name, c.content, c.created_at FROM gw_notice_comment c LEFT JOIN gw_user u ON u.user_id = c.author_id WHERE c.notice_id = #{noticeId} AND c.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY c.created_at
